company.name: Honeydew
company.shortDescription: Honeydew platform is a shared source of data consumers and analysts.
company.description: Honeydew is a shared source of truth for data consumers and analytics. They built a semantic layer designed for collaboration and reusability. The early adopters use the product to standardize metrics. The data for business users; And reuse logic across BI dashboards.

productsAndServices.description: A semantic layer that provides a shared source of truth for business metrics and logic, enabling consistent data access across AI and BI tools.
productsAndServices.name: Honeydew Semantic Layer

productsAndServices.description: Configurable datasets built from semantic layer components, deployable as views, tables, or dynamic tables in Snowflake for flexible data exploration and integration.
productsAndServices.name: Dynamic Datasets

productsAndServices.description: Integration with Snowflake data warehouse enabling deployment and management of semantic models and dynamic datasets with various authentication methods.
productsAndServices.name: Snowflake Integration

productsAndServices.description: Capability allowing business users to query data in natural language via interfaces like Slack, powered by the semantic layer to ensure consistent and accurate answers.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Powered Natural Language Querying

productsAndServices.description: Tools for managing, versioning, and collaborating on semantic models using SQL and YAML, with lineage tracking and impact analysis.
productsAndServices.name: Semantic Layer Management and Collaboration Tools

insights.statement: 1 disclosed grants total $75,000, representing 13.04% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,852,613 to $10,048,949, a 2.07x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 53 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 73 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
